name: DISABLE ACTIVITY HISTORY
description: Stops Windows from recording app usage, document opens, and activity timeline data.

name: DISABLE CONSUMER FEATURES
description: Blocks pre-installed app suggestions, OEM promotions, and feature management telemetry.

name: DISABLE LOCATION TRACKING
description: Disables GPS and WiFi-based location services and tracking across all apps.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\LocationAndSensors' -Name 'DisableLocation' -ErrorAction Stop).DisableLocation; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE STORE RECOMMENDED SEARCH
description: Removes Microsoft Store app suggestions from Windows search results.

name: DISABLE POWERSHELL 7 TELEMETRY
description: Opts out of PowerShell 7 telemetry and data collection sent to Microsoft.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\PowerShellCore' -Name 'EnableTelemetry' -ErrorAction Stop).EnableTelemetry; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE WINDOWS AI
description: Disables Windows Copilot, AI data analysis, and generative AI features.

name: DISABLE WPBT
description: Disables Windows Platform Binary Table to prevent OEM bloatware injection at boot.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager' -Name 'DisableWpbtExecution' -ErrorAction Stop).DisableWpbtExecution; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE ADOBE URL BLOCK LIST
description: Blocks Adobe telemetry and analytics domains via URL block list policies.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Edge\URLBlocklist' -ErrorAction Stop; if ($v.'1' -eq '*.adobe.io') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE WINDOWS TELEMETRY
description: Stops continuous background diagnostic collections, tracking loops, and feedback telemetry queues.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection' -Name 'AllowTelemetry' -ErrorAction Stop).AllowTelemetry; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: RUN DISK CLEANUP
description: Executes Disk Cleanup on C: drive to remove temporary and unnecessary files.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "exit 1"

name: CREATE RESTORE POINT
description: Creates a system restore point named 'AtomToolBox' before making changes.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "exit 1"

name: SET SERVICES TO MANUAL
description: Sets non-essential Windows services to manual start to reduce background resource usage.
command: sc config Fax start=demand && sc config WbioSrvc start=demand && sc config icssvc start=demand && sc config WalletService start=demand && sc config lfsvc start=demand && sc config MapsBroker start=demand && sc config SmsRouter start=demand
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $s = Get-Service -Name 'Fax' -ErrorAction Stop; if ($s.StartType -eq 'Manual') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: REMOVE TEMPORARY FILES
description: Clears user temp, Windows temp, and Prefetch directories to free disk space.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "exit 1"

name: REMOVE UNWANTED PRE-INSTALLED APPS
description: Removes common pre-installed bloatware apps (Candy Crush, Xbox, Spotify, etc.) via PowerShell.
command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-AppxPackage *3dbuilder* | Remove-AppxPackage; Get-AppxPackage *candycrush* | Remove-AppxPackage; Get-AppxPackage *bingfinance* | Remove-AppxPackage; Get-AppxPackage *bingnews* | Remove-AppxPackage; Get-AppxPackage *bingsports* | Remove-AppxPackage; Get-AppxPackage *bingweather* | Remove-AppxPackage; Get-AppxPackage *getstarted* | Remove-AppxPackage; Get-AppxPackage *officehub* | Remove-AppxPackage; Get-AppxPackage *oneconnect* | Remove-AppxPackage; Get-AppxPackage *skypeapp* | Remove-AppxPackage; Get-AppxPackage *solitaire* | Remove-AppxPackage; Get-AppxPackage *spotify* | Remove-AppxPackage; Get-AppxPackage *twitter* | Remove-AppxPackage; Get-AppxPackage *xbox* | Remove-AppxPackage; Get-AppxPackage *zune* | Remove-AppxPackage"
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "exit 1"

check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { Get-AppxPackage *WebExperience* -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null; exit 1 } catch { exit 0 }"

name: REMOVE MICROSOFT ONEDRIVE
description: Uninstalls OneDrive client and removes its Explorer shell integration.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { if (Test-Path '$env:SystemRoot\SysWOW64\OneDriveSetup.exe') { exit 1 } else { exit 0 } } catch { exit 0 }"

name: DEBLOAT MICROSOFT EDGE
description: Disables Edge features: sidebar, shopping, collections, rewards, startup boost, etc.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Edge' -Name 'HubsSidebarEnabled' -ErrorAction Stop).HubsSidebarEnabled; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: REMOVE MICROSOFT EDGE
description: Attempts to uninstall Microsoft Edge browser from the system.
command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$edge = (Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\Microsoft Edge' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).UninstallString; if ($edge) { Start-Process cmd -ArgumentList '/c', $edge, '/uninstall', '/force' -Wait }"
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { if (Test-Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\Microsoft Edge') { exit 1 } else { exit 0 } } catch { exit 0 }"

name: REMOVE XBOX & GAMING
description: Removes Xbox apps, Game Bar, and disables gaming services.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { Get-AppxPackage *xbox* -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null; exit 1 } catch { exit 0 }"

name: DISABLE RAZER AUTO-INSTALL
description: Blocks automatic installation of Razer software via Windows device setup.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\DevicePath' -ErrorAction Stop; if ($v.Razer -eq '') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE IPV6
description: Completely disables IPv6 protocol stack to reduce network overhead and latency.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip6\Parameters' -Name 'DisabledComponents' -ErrorAction Stop).DisabledComponents; if ($v -eq 255) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

description: Keeps IPv6 enabled but prioritizes IPv4 for all network connections.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip6\Parameters' -Name 'DisabledComponents' -ErrorAction Stop).DisabledComponents; if ($v -eq 32) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE TEREDO
description: Disables Teredo IPv6 tunneling protocol to reduce network overhead.
command: netsh interface teredo set state disabled
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $r = netsh interface teredo show state 2>&1 | Out-String; if ($r -match 'disabled') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: SHOW HIDDEN FILES

name: DISABLE SEARCH INDEXING

check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $s = Get-Service -Name 'WSearch' -ErrorAction Stop; if ($s.StartType -eq 'Disabled') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE SYSTEM RESTORE
